steps.content:
You can buy from either seller. I compared the two listings and they match on everything I could see:

| | Ottervale Audio (a) | Brackmoor Sound (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Product | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 |
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1 year limited | 1 year limited |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Colour and box contents | Graphite, with case, USB-C cable and 3.5 mm cable | Same |

The two listings show the same rating and review count. That may mean the reviews are for the product and not for each seller. If so, the ratings tell you nothing about how reliable either seller is.

Since nothing separates them, these are the ways I'd choose:
- **Check seller reputation elsewhere.** Look up each seller's own ratings, such as on Trustpilot, Reddit or the marketplace's seller feedback. This is the most useful tiebreaker.
- **Check that the seller is authorized.** Look at the Quellwyn website to see whether either one is a listed retailer. That matters for honoring the warranty.
- **Check the return process.** If one seller's return policy page is clearer or easier, pick that one. You pay return shipping with both.
- **Pay with a credit card.** It gives you extra protection if something goes wrong, whichever seller you choose.

If you can't find anything else to go on, pick either one. The listings give no reason to prefer one.
